$ auth login --api-key golden-key
Logged in with API key

$ auth status
{
  "apiProvider": "anthropic",
  "authMethod": "api_key",
  "hasAPIKey": true,
  "hasAuthToken": false,
  "loggedIn": true
}

$ auth logout
Logged out

$ auth status
{
  "apiProvider": "anthropic",
  "authMethod": "none",
  "hasAPIKey": false,
  "hasAuthToken": false,
  "loggedIn": false
}
